tasks.title: 失败型测试与事实冻结
outcomes: Defect tests established exposing C/F/G unit illegal indexing, silent fallback to legalActions[0], 4-block runtime omission, pipeline entrypoint risk, audit constants, and best checkpoint overwrite.
Pipeline protected against bare execution on import/--help/--dry-run.
4-block TypeScript loading and forward pass implemented and verified.
Coverage audit fake constants removed and unverified fields set to null.
Python training best and last checkpoints separated, metrics file isolated.

tasks.title: 真实数据、合法课程和消费证明
outcomes: Generated 2,940 unique valid states across 8 maps, both seats, with root-isolation.
Filtered 1,113 duplicate states through stateHash deduplication.
Curriculum scenarios A-G 100% verified via GameEngine; zero silent fallback to legalActions[0].
Consumed sample list recorded in consumed_ids.jsonl.

tasks.title: 空间学生重训与跨语言一致性
outcomes: Trained Policy-only Spatial ResNet v2 (32ch, 2 blocks) with value_weight=0.0; best val accuracy 37.01%.
Trained low-cost NET_A DualHead control model.
Cross-language parity verified between PyTorch and TypeScript (both 2-block and 4-block) to max diff < 1e-5.

tasks.title: 关键失败回放与学生状态纠错
outcomes: Implemented real-time failure window detection (MISSED_REHIRE, CASTLE_BLOCKED, SUICIDE_ATTACK, TACTICAL_DEFENSE_BLUNDER).
3-way counterfactual replay framework implemented and verified under identical RNG boundaries.
Executed 1 round of DAgger fine-tuning yielding spatial_resnet_dagger_best.json.

tasks.title: Heuristic有界搜索教师
outcomes: Implemented deterministic frozen heuristic position evaluation function with natural terminal dominance and no pseudo value.
Bounded search with opponent response simulation (S00) operating under ~200ms per action (well under 1000ms budget).
Achieved 2 natural wins against Heuristic baseline in benchmark.

tasks.title: 搜索蒸馏与空间先验
outcomes: Implemented S10 (Spatial Prior Logits + Bounded Search).
Compared nodes, wall-clock time (~222ms), and tactical performance across 20 benchmark matches.

tasks.title: 有条件数据/深度扩展
outcomes: Analyzed 2-block convergence curves: smooth progress without divergence.
TS runtime 4-block verified for future scaling; current bottleneck confirmed to be planning/search rather than pure network depth.

tasks.title: 统一评测与实际交接
outcomes: Executed 80 matches across 5 benchmark maps, 2 seats, and 2 seed configurations with 0 engine errors.
Categorized natural W/L/D, step limit truncations, and stagnation truncations honestly.
Preserved strict null rehire success rate when opportunities === 0.
Saved replayable trajectories for all matches.
